capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: Gross 82 kWh like the Long Range AWD (ArenaEV). No page found for the US 2024 Long Range RWD pack (EV Database 3363 is the European 2025-26 Premium RWD, not used). Basis: Notebookcheck (src-notebookcheck-model-y-premium-rwd-2026) says the US RWD of the Juniper range "has the same battery size as its AWD sibling"; carried from the 82/75 pack of the same-line Long Range AWD. OpenEV Data lists an LFP 78/75 170 kW pack for the 2024/2025 Long Range RWD, which conflicts and is not used.
